写作句式.cn: 其次，在线问诊、AI 诊断等健康服务的数字化，使居民能够便捷快速地获得专业建议。
写作句式.src: 英语二大作文 · 套用示范（2023）

写作句式.en: The upward trend stems from students' growing wish to gain practical experience.
写作句式.cn: 这一上升趋势源于学生获取实践经验意愿的增强。
写作句式.src: 英语二大作文 · 套用示范（2013）

写作句式.w: regard … as a vivid classroom where children learn through discovery
写作句式.meaning: 把……视为孩子通过探索来学习的生动课堂
写作句式.en: On the one hand, the high value placed on curiosity and observation suggests that parents increasingly regard the outdoor world as a vivid classroom where children learn through discovery.
写作句式.src: 英语二大作文 · 套用示范（2026）

写作句式.en: On the other hand, an increasing number of restaurants with similar prices are available, so distinctive features have become the key to standing out.
写作句式.src: 英语二大作文 · 套用示范（2018）

写作句式.en: Moreover, as living standards improve, the public demand increasingly varied spiritual nourishment, and visiting museums has therefore become a willing choice for more people.
写作句式.cn: 此外，随着生活水平提高，公众对多样化精神食粮的需求上升，参观博物馆因而成为更多人的自愿选择。
写作句式.src: 英语二大作文 · 套用示范（2017）

写作句式.w: boosted the popularity of doing workouts at home
写作句式.meaning: 推动了居家锻炼的流行
写作句式.en: Furthermore, a wide range of fitness videos, apps and games have boosted the popularity of doing workouts at home.
写作句式.cn: 此外，大量健身视频、应用与游戏也推动了居家独自锻炼的流行。
写作句式.src: 英语二大作文 · 套用示范（2021）

写作句式.en: Relevant authorities should channel more resources into the countryside and create favorable conditions for local employment, so that rural residents can also benefit from national progress.
写作句式.cn: 有关部门应向农村倾斜更多资源，为本地就业创造有利条件，让农村居民也能从国家发展中获益。
写作句式.src: 英语二大作文 · 套用示范（2014）

写作句式.w: give impetus to the delivery business
写作句式.en: The bar chart shows that the express delivery volumes associated with the whole country and rural areas rose steadily from 2018 to 2020.
写作句式.cn: 该柱状图表明，2018 至 2020 年间全国与农村的快递业务量均持续上升。
写作句式.src: 英语二大作文 · 套用示范（2022）

写作句式.w: keep pace with the public demand
写作句式.en: Relevant authorities should improve the supply of cultural services, so that the growth of facilities can keep pace with the public demand.
写作句式.cn: 有关部门应改善文化服务供给，使设施增长能够跟上公众日益增长的需求。
写作句式.src: 英语二大作文 · 套用示范（2017）

写作句式.en: However, we should not go to extremes.
写作句式.cn: 然而，我们不应走极端。
写作句式.src: 英语二大作文 · 套用示范（2015）

写作句式.en: In the twenty years, urban sprawl transformed millions of peasants into city residents, and many more chose to leave their hometowns on their own initiative.
写作句式.cn: 二十年间，城市扩张使数百万农民被动转为城镇居民，更多人则主动离开家乡。
写作句式.src: 英语二大作文 · 套用示范（2014）

写作句式.w: paves the way for their career development
写作句式.en: Firstly, the practical knowledge offered by the course enables students to better understand their interests and paves the way for their career development.
写作句式.src: 英语二大作文 · 套用示范（2024）

写作句式.en: Moreover, the government has made sustained efforts to improve infrastructure in the countryside, which paves the way for courier services to extend to the vast rural markets.
写作句式.cn: 此外，政府持续改善农村基础设施，为快递服务延伸到广阔的农村市场铺平了道路。
写作句式.src: 英语二大作文 · 套用示范（2022）

写作句式.en: For physical exercise to bring lasting benefits, individuals should make well-informed choices in light of their own circumstances, while relevant authorities should provide more public sports facilities.
写作句式.cn: 要使体育锻炼带来长久收益，个人应结合自身情况作出理性选择，有关部门也应提供更多公共体育设施。
写作句式.src: 英语二大作文 · 套用示范（2021）

写作句式.en: On the one hand, as the job market becomes increasingly competitive, a higher degree is widely regarded as a way to secure an advantage.
写作句式.src: 英语二大作文 · 套用示范（2019）

写作句式.w: stay competitive in the job market
写作句式.meaning: 在就业市场中保持竞争力
写作句式.en: Moreover, the awareness of self-improvement has spread widely among university students who wish to stay competitive in the job market.
写作句式.cn: 此外，希望在就业市场保持竞争力的学生中，自我提升意识已广泛传播。
写作句式.src: 英语二大作文 · 套用示范（2020）

写作句式.w: strike a balance between work and study
写作句式.en: Universities should provide more internship channels, while students should strike a balance between work and study in light of their own circumstances.
写作句式.cn: 高校应提供更多实习渠道，学生也应结合自身情况平衡好学业与工作。
写作句式.src: 英语二大作文 · 套用示范（2013）

写作句式.en: Moreover, hands-on experience is highly valued in today's job market, which encourages students to focus on applicable skills.
写作句式.src: 英语二大作文 · 套用示范（2024）

写作句式.en: The line chart shows that the health literacy rate of Chinese residents rose steadily from 2012 to 2021.
写作句式.cn: 该折线图表明，2012 至 2021 年间中国居民健康素养水平持续上升。
写作句式.src: 英语二大作文 · 套用示范（2023）

写作句式.en: On the one hand, as per capita disposable income has risen, more people can afford to dine out, and it is natural that they care more about high-quality enjoyment than about price.
写作句式.src: 英语二大作文 · 套用示范（2018）
